meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描你在 Azure 上的 Functions 和 App Service 资源，输出一张按可靠性特性排列的清单（区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探针、多区域故障转移），并在你确认后分阶段用 az CLI 或改 IaC 文件来修复。
howto.when: 当你提到“评估可靠性”“区域冗余”“多区域故障转移”等关键词，或要求排查单点故障、检查灾难恢复就绪度时触发。目前只覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 评估我这个资源组的可靠性
say.note: 先给出四项特性的检查清单

say.text: 把我的应用服务计划改成区域冗余
帮我改 IaC，加多区域故障转移
say.note: 修改 Bicep/Terraform 文件，不动线上资源

howto.what_en: Claude scans your deployed Azure Functions and App Service resources, shows a feature-based checklist (zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, multi-region failover), and after your OK fixes items in stages via az CLI or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover" etc., or asks about single points of failure or disaster recovery readiness. Covers Azure Functions and App Service only.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my resource group
Make my app service plan zone redundant
say_en.note: Confirms with you before running any change

say_en.text: Patch my IaC to set up multi-region failover
say_en.note: Edits your Bicep/Terraform, not live resources
